original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning Workload Identity Federation for a GitHub Actions workflow that needs to deploy Cloud Run services.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
imports:
- path: wif.jinja

resources:
- name: github-wif
  type: wif.jinja
  properties:
    projectId: {{ env["project"] }}
    projectNumber: {{ env["project_number"] }}
    poolId: github-actions-pool
    poolDisplayName: GitHub Actions Pool
    providerId: github-provider
    providerDisplayName: GitHub Provider
    githubOrg: my-github-org
    githubRepo: my-github-repo
    serviceAccountId: github-cloud-run-deployer
    serviceAccountDisplayName: GitHub Actions Cloud Run Deployer
    region: us-central1

---
# wif.jinja
resources:
- name: {{ properties["poolId"] }}
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ properties["projectId"] }}/locations/global
    workloadIdentityPoolId: {{ properties["poolId"] }}
    workloadIdentityPool:
      displayName: {{ properties["poolDisplayName"] }}
      description: Workload Identity Pool for GitHub Actions CI/CD
      disabled: false

- name: {{ properties["providerId"] }}
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.locations.workloadIdentityPools.providers
  properties:
    parent: projects/{{ properties["projectId"] }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{{ properties["poolId"] }}
    workloadIdentityPoolProviderId: {{ properties["providerId"] }}
    workloadIdentityPoolProvider:
      displayName: {{ properties["providerDisplayName"] }}
      description: OIDC provider for GitHub Actions
      disabled: false
      attributeCondition: |
        assertion.repository_owner == '{{ properties["githubOrg"] }}'
      attributeMapping:
        google.subject: assertion.sub
        attribute.actor: assertion.actor
        attribute.repository: assertion.repository
        attribute.repository_owner: assertion.repository_owner
        attribute.ref: assertion.ref
        attribute.event_name: assertion.event_name
      oidc:
        issuerUri: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
        allowedAudiences:
          - https://iam.googleapis.com/projects/{{ properties["projectNumber"] }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{{ properties["poolId"] }}/providers/{{ properties["providerId"] }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
      - {{ properties["poolId"] }}

- name: {{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}
  type: gcp-types/iam-v1:projects.serviceAccounts
  properties:
    accountId: {{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}
    projectId: {{ properties["projectId"] }}
    serviceAccount:
      displayName: {{ properties["serviceAccountDisplayName"] }}
      description: Service account impersonated by GitHub Actions to deploy Cloud Run services

- name: sa-wif-binding
  action: gcp-types/iam-v1:iam.projects.serviceAccounts.setIamPolicy
  properties:
    resource: projects/{{ properties["projectId"] }}/serviceAccounts/{{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}@{{ properties["projectId"] }}.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    policy:
      bindings:
        - role: roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser
          members:
            - principalSet://iam.googleapis.com/projects/{{ properties["projectNumber"] }}/locations/global/workloadIdentityPools/{{ properties["poolId"] }}/attribute.repository/{{ properties["githubOrg"] }}/{{ properties["githubRepo"] }}
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
      - {{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}
      - {{ properties["providerId"] }}

- name: project-iam-policy
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: {{ properties["projectId"] }}
    role: roles/run.admin
    member: serviceAccount:{{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}@{{ properties["projectId"] }}.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
      - {{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}

- name: project-iam-sa-user
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: {{ properties["projectId"] }}
    role: roles/iam.serviceAccountUser
    member: serviceAccount:{{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}@{{ properties["projectId"] }}.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
      - {{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}

- name: project-iam-artifact-writer
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: {{ properties["projectId"] }}
    role: roles/artifactregistry.writer
    member: serviceAccount:{{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}@{{ properties["projectId"] }}.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  metadata:
    dependsOn:
      - {{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}

- name: project-iam-storage-admin
  type: gcp-types/cloudresourcemanager-v1:virtual.projects.iamMemberBinding
  properties:
    resource: {{ properties["projectId"] }}
    role: roles/storage.admin
    member: serviceAccount:{{ properties["serviceAccountId"] }}@{{ properties["projectId"] }}.iam.g
